records.status: Repaired and regression verified in completed project
records.defect: PostgreSQL jobs retried instead of delivering decoded JSONB records.
records.root_cause: Dispatcher unconditionally called json.loads although psycopg returns a dict for JSONB.
records.repair: Accept decoded dict or serialized JSON at the adapter boundary.

regression_verification.scope: Final 410-case replay verifies current behavior; historical-only items do not claim a new pre-repair execution.

records.status: Repaired and regression verified in completed project
records.defect: Concurrent PostgreSQL matrix registration could raise a hash unique-constraint violation.
records.root_cause: ON CONFLICT(id) omitted the separate unique hash constraint reached by racing clients.
records.repair: Use untargeted ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING for the two fingerprint-derived unique constraints; retain ingestion content/identity conflict checks.

regression_verification.scope: Final 410-case replay verifies current behavior; historical-only items do not claim a new pre-repair execution.

records.reusable_lesson: Test all relevant uniqueness constraints with genuinely competing independent connections.
